nodes.title: Rotor limit loads per motor and design dive speed
nodes.equation: T_cap = kT_E1 T_h (rpm_cap/rpm_h)^2 ; T_ilim = t_ilim g ; T_lim = max(T_req, T_cap) ; rpm_lim = rpm_h sqrt(T_lim / (kT_E1 T_h)) ; Q = kP_E1 Q_h (rpm_lim/rpm_h)^2 ; H = (m_p D^2/12 + I_bell) omega ; M_gyro = H q_max ; V_pitch = p rpm_fw/60 (fixed-wing rpm at F4's THR_MAX) ; VH = max(V_pitch, V_lvl_F4) ; VD = f_D max(Vc, VH) rounded UP to 0.1 m/s ; VD_uncapped = f_D max(Vc, VMAX_B1) (information) ; n_hover = n T_lim / (m g)

nodes.title: V-n diagram: manoeuvre and gust envelope
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2W/(rho S CLmax)); VA = Vs sqrt(n+); a = CL_alpha (B2 AVL); mu = 2(W/S)/(rho c a g); kg = 0.88mu/(5.3+mu); dn = kg rho U V a / (2 W/S); n_gust = min(stall line, 1 +/- dn), U = Ude_C to VC then linear to f Ude_C at VD; VD = max(VD_req, VD_C1); design n = max(requirement, gust)

nodes.title: Landing, wingtip strike, tip-over and stance-in-wind loads
nodes.equation: feet (constant-force cartridge, eta_f): n_L = v^2/(2 g eta_f s) + 1 - L/W at s = s_min (requirement) and s = foot height (bound) ; s_req = v^2 / (2 g eta_f (n_target - 1 + L/W)) ; F_foot at n_target = m_eff g (n_target - 1 + L/W) + (1 - L/W) W/4 with m_eff = 1/(1/m + (r x n).I^-1.(r x n)) ; level upper foot x bias ; wingtip strike roll = atan(foot / (b/2 - y_fin)) ; foot_req = (b/2 - y_fin) tan(attitude) ; tip-over: KE = m g r (1 - cos(phi0 + theta_c)) ; F = KE / (eta s) ; stance wind: q S CD h = W d

nodes.title: Crash factor and pack retention load
nodes.equation: n_c = v^2 / (2 g s) ; F_pack = m_pack_max n_c g (ultimate, emergency)

nodes.title: Box drop load factor
Lumped-model mass properties against A3's roll-up
nodes.equation: I_model from the lumped masses at the gate (MC-C, MC-P, after the Iyy match) ; ratio = I_model / (I_A3 x s) per axis, s = 1 for MC-C (growth at the CG) and m_gate / m_A3 for MC-P (pro rata) ; trim dx = centre-group x shift that puts the model CG on the limit ; d = centre-group spread

nodes.title: D5's per-type foot loads inside C1's level-landing bound
nodes.equation: r_lim = F_peak_upper(D5) / F_level_upper(C1) ; r_ult = F_ult_upper(D5) / (SF F_level_upper(C1))

nodes.title: Load envelope over every case and both mass configurations
nodes.equation: per case: a = F/m, alpha = I^-1 M_cg ; cut load = sum over the outboard part of (applied + m (g - a - alpha x r)) ; envelope = max over cases F, H, T, L1-L5, G and mass configs MC-C, MC-P ; ultimate = SF x limit ; joints x fitting factor ; transport n_allow = n_T x min(envelope / transport) ; s_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1))

nodes.note: CR-C4-29: replaces ASM-C4-G3-CAN-F 23.2 N. Worst of MC-C / MC-P; ultimate x 1.5.

nodes.title: Set-down (G3) reaction on one lower motor can, ultimate
nodes.how: As CL-C1-G3-CAN-F x 1.5.

nodes.title: Pack-to-tray resultant (aft stop and strap), landing at n 6.6, limit
nodes.how: T-C3-STOP-PUSH: push the bonded aft stop with this load x 1.5 (C3).
nodes.note: D-65: the pack stop is checked at landing_n_design 6.6 at the gate. Mostly +x (aft stop). Crash retention is separate (CL-C1-PACK-CRASH-LOAD, ultimate, emergency).

nodes.title: Pack-to-tray resultant, landing at n 6.6, ultimate
nodes.how: As CL-C1-PACK-STOP-LIM x 1.5.

nodes.how: T-C3-POD-PROOF at this load (C3, H1).
nodes.note: D-65: at landing_n_design 6.6 (L1 governs).

nodes.title: Design foot side load at the pad, limit (max of friction and C5's 3-D sim)
nodes.how: T-D5-SIDE pull on the shoe; C5's 6-DOF sim (CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD).
nodes.note: D-65 / CR-C5-16: applied with the corner foot load in L4 (y) and L5 (z).

nodes.title: Design foot side load at the pad, ultimate
nodes.how: As CL-C1-FOOT-SIDE-DESIGN x 1.5.

nodes.title: Box front-wall impact factor with the pod nose on the nose pad
nodes.how: Label-and-test (D-53): T-D7-BOX-DROP front-wall drop with the dummy; D7's nose-drop height h = (n - 1) eta eps_use t_nosepad uses this factor, not CL-C1-TRANSPORT-N-ALLOW-X.
nodes.note: Case X6: the transport mass is stopped through the pod nose (J-POD carries everything but the pod group). X1 (cradle-reacted) only holds while the cradles stop the aircraft before the nose reaches the pad.

nodes.title: Centre-group z shift that puts the lumped model CG at cg.z_target_m (MC-C)
nodes.how: Information (D-62): A3's CL-A3-CG-Z replaces cg.z_target_m when published.

nodes.title: Box aft-wall impact factor, four feet crushing at D5's plateaus
nodes.how: Loaded-box drop on the aft wall with an accelerometer on the spar (D7 T-D7-BOX-DROP); cartridges replaced after.
nodes.note: n = sum of the four plateaus / transport weight (props and pack out); independent of the drop height while the 35 mm usable foot stroke lasts (D7 CL-D7-AFT-DROP-ALLOW).

nodes.title: Wing proof load at limit (the one wing limit proof, run as H1 GT-08)
nodes.procedure: Aircraft inverted, supported under the pod with the half-fins hanging free; four-pad whiffletree per side over the spar at CL-C1-PROOF-Y1/-Y2/-Y3/-Y4 loaded to CL-C1-PROOF-P1/P2/P3/P4-LIM, plus the upward relief pull CL-C1-PROOF-R-LIM at each motor tube (LIMIT; data/whiffletree.json); hold 3 s, no permanent set after unloading; tip deflection logged. Step 2, each side in turn (rolling cases): padded V-block under the spar at CL-C1-PROOF-OUT-SUPPORT-Y, pads 3 and 4 at CL-C1-PROOF-OUT-P3/P4-LIM. Ultimate (x 1.5) on a sacrificial wing only. Torsion: twist test at CL-C1-WING-TORSION-ULT / 1.5; the G2 tube-end handling moment: T-C1-STATION-PROOF (CR-H1-13, agreed with C2).

nodes.title: Foot drop test at 1.5 m/s
nodes.procedure: 0.115 m free drop of the aircraft (or a 2.6 kg dummy on one fin) onto its feet, accelerometer at the CG; level and 10 deg tilted; n <= 6.

nodes.title: Max thrust on a fresh pack
nodes.procedure: H1 thrust stand, one station, 11x5.5MR, 16.8 V pack, F4 output cap and 100 A limiter as flown: step to full throttle, record peak thrust, torque and rpm.

nodes.title: Motor-station proof load
nodes.procedure: Hang the limit mount load from each motor mount in -x and y with the wing supported at the spar. G2 step (CR-H1-13): wing held under the pod, a load equal to the G2 fin-group cut (data/envelope.json, J-FIN in G2-HANG-MOTOR) hung at the UR upper tube end at LIMIT; no permanent set.
